item.title: International Women's Day march advocates for women's rights
item.description: (COLORADO SPRINGS) -- The University of Colorado Colorado Springs (UCCS) Feminist Club organized a march through downtown Colorado Springs on Sunday, March 8, to observe International Women's Day and advocate for women's rights. item.title: Singleton, Dobbins staying put with Broncos, sign 2-year deals
item.description: There's another one, and another one — the Denver Broncos are bringing linebacker Alex Singleton and running back JK Dobbins back to the team after they signed new two-year deals.

item.title: Trump tells Republicans the SAVE America Act will 'guarantee the midterms'
item.description: DORAL, Fla. - President Trump on Monday pushed for the passage of a GOP voting requirements bill, telling House Republicans that enacting the legislation will “guarantee the midterms” and reiterating that he won’t sign any other bills until it gets passed. “It will guarantee the midterms. item.title: Teens charged in NYC bomb attempt wanted to surpass Boston Marathon terror attack, prosecutors say
item.description: Two ISIS-inspired men accused of trying to detonate bombs at New York City protests wanted to cause a terror attack bigger than the Boston Marathon, according to federal prosecutors.
